rules.reason: May request application launch through the future mediated launcher interface.
May read only its namespaced settings through the future settings mediator.
General third-party applets may not mutate compositor-owned window state.
The audited shell composition may own the standard registrar and read the authenticated active provider's dbusmenu endpoint.
Menu Event delivery does not grant general compositor window activation authority.
The audited Clipboard applet may observe the bounded metadata-only history projection through its injected client seam.
The audited Clipboard applet may dispatch generation-fenced select, pin, delete, and clear intents; execution stays with the clipboard authority.
Window inventory observation stays with the audited Task List applet; third-party packages have no compositor window read authority.
Window activation stays with the audited Task List applet's generation-fenced intents; third-party packages may not activate windows.
